title: Homily XXX
subtitle: Matthew 9:9
author: chrysostom
excerpt: For when He had performed the miracle, He did not remain, lest, being in sight, He should kindle their jealousy the more; but He indulges them by retiring, and…

footnotes.6: It appears by this that St. Chrysostom did not consider Nathanael to be the same with St. Bartholomew.
